verification_commands.ac1: bash -c 'cd backend && test -f pyproject.toml && grep -Eq "requires-python *= *\"[^\"]*3\.12" pyproject.toml && for p in fastapi uvicorn sqlalchemy alembic pydantic python-jose passlib httpx pytest-cov pytest-asyncio pytest ruff mypy; do grep -qi -- "$p" pyproject.toml || exit 1; done && test -f uv.lock'
verification_commands.ac2: bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v uv >/dev/null || exit 1; cd backend && uv sync >/dev/null 2>&1'
verification_commands.ac3: bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v uv >/dev/null || exit 1; cd backend && test -f app/main.py && grep -Eq "def create_app" app/main.py && grep -Eq "^app *= *create_app" app/main.py && uv run pytest tests/unit/test_smoke.py -q >/dev/null 2>&1'
verification_commands.ac4: bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v uv >/dev/null || exit 1; cd backend && out=$(uv run pytest -q 2>&1) || exit 1; echo "$out" | grep -Eq "[1-9][0-9]* passed"'
verification_commands.ac5: bash -c 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd backend && uv run ruff check . >/dev/null 2>&1 && uv run mypy . >/dev/null 2>&1'
